job.description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript) - 3-Month Contract

The Opportunity

Emanate Technology is partnering with a well-established national professional services organisation in Melbourne undergoing a major core platform modernisation program.
They are rebuilding their legacy operational and practice management ecosystem from the ground up into a modern, cloud-native, serverless architecture. We are looking for a hands-on Senior Backend Engineer for an initial 3-month contract to join a lean product pod and take ownership of complex backend services, asynchronous event pipelines, and third-party API integrations.
This is a pure backend engineering seat suited to someone who can hit the ground running, untangle complex integration patterns, write clean production TypeScript, and build resilient distributed systems without getting bogged down in red tape.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Designing, building, and maintaining serverless backend services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Engineering event-driven workflows, queues, and idempotent consumers to handle reliable data synchronisation across internal and external platforms.
  • Building and securing integration layers between modern cloud services and legacy core systems.
  • Modelling and querying NoSQL document databases to support high-availability application workflows.
  • Collaborating closely within a cross-functional squad alongside a Tech Lead to ship tested, production-ready code through automated CI/CD pipelines.
What We Are Looking For

  • Core Stack: Strong, recent commercial experience building production backend services in modern Node.js and TypeScript (this is a pure backend role, not a frontend or UI position).
  • Serverless & Cloud: Proven hands-on delivery with serverless compute and cloud infrastructure across AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge) and/or Azure (Azure Functions, Service Bus, APIM).
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Practical experience designing asynchronous messaging patterns, pub/sub workflows, and reliable retry/dead-letter handling.
  • Data Layer: Solid experience working with NoSQL document stores (such as DynamoDB, Cosmos DB, or MongoDB) alongside relational databases.
  • Production Ownership: Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, and production observability tools.
Contract Details & Setup

  • Duration: 3-month contract
  • Location: Melbourne CBD (hybrid working rhythm with 2 days in the office and 3 days working from home)
  • Start Date: Immediate / 2 weeks notice preferred (Australian Citizens or Permanent Residents required)

job.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on UX/UI Designer for an immediate three-month contract with an established public sector digital team based in Melbourne's inner east.

Following an unexpected surge in customer-facing project priorities this quarter, the team needs an additional designer to join their agile digital practice. You will jump straight into active sprint delivery alongside a supportive UX Lead and product team, helping uplift existing digital customer experiences and keeping planned releases on track.

This is a delivery-focused sprint: high on practical Figma craft and design-system work, without getting bogged down by lengthy discovery cycles or heavy public-sector red tape.

Key Responsibilities
  • Hands-on Interface Design: Wireframe, prototype, and design clean, intuitive user journeys in Figma for outward-facing digital services.

  • Design System Enhancement: Work with and evolve an established design system, creating reusable components and updating pattern libraries aligned with WCAG accessibility standards.

  • Experience Uplift: Elevate current customer experiences through refreshed visual styling, interaction design, and interface concepts.

  • Developer Handover: Partner closely with front-end engineers to assess technical feasibility, provide clear design specifications, and support features through implementation.

  • Validation and Testing: Conduct light customer research, usability testing, and concept reviews to validate design decisions with evidence.

What We Are Looking For
  • Figma Execution: Daily fluency in Figma, including auto-layout, component architecture, variants, and interactive prototyping.

  • Design Systems Experience: Proven track record working with, maintaining, or expanding component libraries.

  • Clear Design Rationale: Ability to articulate the reasoning behind your design choices using customer feedback, metrics, or usability testing insights.

  • Collaborative Delivery: Experience working alongside developers and product colleagues in an agile setup, ensuring designs translate smoothly into code.

  • Relevant Portfolio (Essential): A current portfolio showcasing your end-to-end design craft, UI polish, and personal contribution across complex web or digital services.

  • Background: Agency or commercial digital product experience (such as higher education, telecommunications, insurance, or logistics) is highly valued; prior government experience is not required.

Why Apply?
  • Streamlined Interview Process: Decisive one-stage process consisting of a single 30-minute case study walk-through with the UX Lead, with no design tests.

  • Work-Life Balance: Clear hybrid working rhythm with 2 days on-site in Camberwell and 3 days remote.

  • Immediate Commercial Impact: Hit the ground running on a defined 12-week delivery backlog where your designs move into production quickly.




We are an inclusive employer committed to fostering a diverse and accessible workplace. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disabilities, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people of all ages, and those from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds.

job.title: Strategic Delivery Manager
job.description:
Griffith University | 12-month fixed term | Brisbane South (Nathan) campus

Emanate Technology is proud to partner with Griffith University to recruit a Strategic Delivery Manager.

Digital Solutions. A team you'll want to be a part of.

When you join Digital Solutions, you'll be part of a team that delivers impact by enhancing digital experiences for the graduates of tomorrow, researchers of today and all those working to make it a brighter future.

But we know it's not just what you do that matters, it's who you do it with. Our people will tell you - our team sets us apart. We promise a supportive and friendly environment where you'll collaborate to make an impact.

Make it matter. Join Digital Solutions at Griffith.

About the opportunity

Lead the planning and delivery of a portfolio of strategic initiatives that support the University's goals and operational priorities. Working across multiple business areas, you will coordinate complex projects and change initiatives, collaborate with stakeholders to define priorities and delivery plans, and ensure successful implementation of new services, processes, and systems.

You will drive a consistent and effective approach to change management, stakeholder engagement, and service transition, while partnering with leaders and delivery teams to achieve outcomes that enhance the student, staff, and research experience. The role also champions continuous improvement of project and delivery practices, tools, and capabilities across the University. Success in this role will be driven by the ability to build trusted relationships across the University's research community, translate strategic objectives into deliverable programs of work, influence decision-making at all levels, and ensure initiatives deliver measurable organisational outcomes. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable engaging with executive leaders, researchers, and delivery teams

What you'll do

· Lead the planning and delivery of strategic initiatives that support University priorities and operational goals.

· Partner with stakeholders to identify needs, provide advice, and develop practical solutions to complex challenges.

· Manage demand, priorities, and business requests, ensuring resources are aligned to organisational needs.

· Oversee a portfolio of projects, programs, and services, monitoring progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes.

· Lead change planning and implementation activities, ensuring successful adoption of new systems, processes, and ways of working.

· Support service transitions and readiness activities to ensure solutions are effectively embedded into operations.

· Prepare and present recommendations, business cases, risks, trade-offs and benefits to senior leadership and executive stakeholders to support informed decision-making.

· Build strong relationships with stakeholders, influencing decision-making and facilitating effective collaboration.

· Lead, coach, and develop staff, fostering a high-performance, customer-focused, and continuous improvement culture.

· Monitor performance and drive improvements to business processes, services, and delivery practices.

About you

Essential Experience

· Strategic stakeholder engagement and relationship management.

· Experience translating business strategy into programs, initiatives or portfolios of work.

· Program, portfolio, PMO or delivery governance experience.

· Business case development and investment planning.

· Executive communication and influencing capability.

· Benefits realisation and outcome-focused delivery.

· Experience managing competing priorities, service demand, strategic investment decisions and delivery pipelines within complex organisations.

Highly Desirable

· Higher education or research-sector experience.

· Research governance, research platforms or research enablement exposure.

· Experience working with academics, researchers or research institutes.

· Portfolio management or PMO establishment experience.

What we can offer

This is a fixed term opportunity for 12 months primarily based at Griffith University Brisbane South (Nathan) campus. As Griffith is a multi-site university, you may be required to work across other locations.

Griffith University's sites are located on the lands of the Yugarabul, Yuggera, Jagera, Turrbal, Yugambeh and Kombumerri peoples.

Salary: A competitive salary will be negotiated with the preferred candidate.

Why join Griffith?

As a values-led organisation, at Griffith University, we've worked hard to create a dynamic and strong organisational culture. We offer:

· Wide range of Learning and Development opportunities

· Mix of on campus and work from home options available and a supportive work environment

· Salary packaging options and corporate health discounts

· Generous leave entitlements including paid parental leave and leave loading

· Support with future learning opportunities through our educational staff assistance scheme

· Opportunities for internal mobility

· Health Safety and Wellbeing initiatives - on campus Gym facilities

Griffith University values diversity, inclusion and flexibility and we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply.

How to apply

Emanate Technology is managing this recruitment on behalf of Griffith University. Please apply with your CV and a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role. For a confidential conversation, contact Alex Moggs, Project Services Consultant, Emanate Technology, on 0422 306 025 or alex.moggs@emanatetechnology.com.au

Closing date: Friday 16 October 2026.


We are an inclusive employer committed to fostering a diverse and accessible workplace.
